common.pauseRequired: Pause the simulation to do this.

errors.fetchNetwork: {url}: download failed (network error, or the site does not allow reading it: CORS).

top.openFilesHint: Loads all the files of a .nfs file.
top.openAppHint: Loads a .nwa file (you can also drop it on the page).
top.openDataHint: Loads the application's external data file.
top.openKeysHint: Loads a .nmk file, which maps computer keys and touch gestures to calculator keys.
top.openStateHint: Resumes a saved emulation (.nds) exactly where it stopped.
top.modelHint: Emulated calculator model: N0110 and N0115 (192 MHz) or N0120 (540 MHz).
top.firmwareHint: Firmware layout: apps written with eadkp only find the file system on the layout of the surveyed devices (Epsilon 23–24).
top.pauseHint: Freezes the simulation: for the application, time stops.
top.restartHint: Restarts the application from the beginning.

screen.dropAppSub: or use the menu at the top left
screen.dropDataSub: This application needs a data file.
screen.label: Calculator screen
screen.exitHint: Press Space to exit full screen.

calc.label: Calculator
calc.notMapped: No computer key or gesture mapped.

mini.label: Simulation information
mini.openPanel: Open the settings and tools panel
mini.statusHint: Whether the simulation is running, paused, or the app has ended or crashed.
mini.framesHint: Number of screen frames drawn since launch (60 per second on the calculator).
mini.timeHint: How long the application has been running. It stops while the simulation is paused.
mini.speedHint: Frequency of the emulated processor. Set it in the Settings tab.
mini.faultHint: The application did something illegal (invalid memory access, unknown instruction…) and stopped.
mini.captureHint: Saves the screen as a PNG image.
mini.fullscreenHint: Shows only the screen, without the keys. Space or Escape to exit.

panel.label: Tools panel
panel.resizeHint: Drag to resize (or use the left and right arrows).

files.storageHint: Space used in the memory that holds the calculator's scripts and settings.
files.corrupt: The file system is damaged at byte {offset} (by the app?).
files.importNfsHint: Loads all the files of a .nfs file.
files.importMode:
{name}: replace all the calculator's files with those of the file?
“Cancel” keeps the existing files (those with the same name are replaced).
files.exportNfsHint: Saves all the calculator's files into a .nfs file.
files.hint: Right-click (or Menu key) to rename, download or delete. F2 renames, Delete deletes.
files.opaque: Opaque format: only download is offered. Here are the first bytes.

state.title: Emulation state
state.help: Saves the app, memory, files and registers in a .nds file so you can resume later, exactly at the same point.
state.saveHint: Saves the state to a .nds file.

hints.app: needed to resume on another computer

memory.heapHint: Memory the application requests as it goes (malloc). The bar shows the highest point reached.
memory.stackHint: Memory for function calls and local variables. The bar shows the deepest point reached.

memmap.label: Memory map
memmap.markerHint: {name} at {address}: see in the Structures tab
memmap.simulatedWhole: {name}: the calculator's system does not exist here, the emulator plays its role.
memmap.note: Real: what the application sees as on a real calculator (its code, RAM, files). Simulated: what the emulator fabricates in place of the system (headers, kernel RAM…). Click an area to view it in hex.

hex.label: Hex editor
hex.fillValue: Fill {count} byte(s) with the hexadecimal value:
hex.pauseToEdit: Pause the simulation to edit memory.
hex.unmapped: {address} is not in any memory region.
hex.badByte: Invalid value: two hexadecimal digits are expected.
hex.badPattern: Invalid pattern: hexadecimal bytes (de ad be ef) or quoted text.
hex.help: Click or use arrows to move, Shift to select, type two hex digits to change a byte (while paused), Ctrl+C to copy, Ctrl+V to paste bytes. Orange bytes have just changed.

structures.invalid: Invalid: the structure does not look as expected (overwritten by the app?).
structures.name: Name
structures.notFound: Structure not found at the expected address.

descriptions.slot_info: Start of RAM: where the active slot's kernel and userland are. Re-read from memory each time.
descriptions.slot_header: Security level and size of the slot's signed payload.
descriptions.kernel_header: Epsilon version and build commit identifier, in the kernel.
descriptions.userland_header: What the kernel knows about the userland: app areas, storage, device name.
descriptions.vector_table: Userland entry points: initial stack, start, text drawing function.
descriptions.storage: The calculator's file buffer in RAM, with its start and end markers.
descriptions.apps: External apps written to flash, re-read from memory.
descriptions.app: What linking did with the application: addresses of code, data and heap.

keys.name: Mapping name
keys.help: Highlighted calculator keys have a binding. Hover one to see which; click one to edit it.
keys.selectHint: Click a calculator key to see and edit its bindings.
keys.notMapped: Nothing is bound to this key.
keys.byPosition: by position (same on AZERTY and QWERTY)
keys.pressAKey: Press the computer key to bind…
keys.addToCombo: Add a key to the combination

settings.speedHelp: The model sets the real frequency (192 or 540 MHz); “unlimited” runs the app as fast as possible, paced by the 60 frames per second.
settings.help: Each setting is rewritten where the device keeps it (flash headers, name, FCC…): applications see it through system calls or by reading memory.

hints.device_name: Name the user gave the calculator; empty: none.
hints.fcc_id: Shown by the About app and returned by the fcc_id system call.
hints.serial_number: Returned by the serial_number_copy system call.
hints.software_version: Epsilon version written in the kernel header.
hints.expected_userland_version: Userland version the kernel expects: it differs after a partial update.
hints.brightness: In steps of 16: 0, 16, … 240, as on the calculator.
hints.usb_plugged: What the app reads when asking whether USB is plugged in.
hints.exam_mode: Hides external apps: they can no longer be launched.
hints.clearance_level: 0 official, 1 third-party apps installed, 2 third-party userland.
hints.compilation_flags: Value returned by the compilation_flags system call.

trace.cpuHelp: Registers at the time of the last read; those that just changed are highlighted.
trace.svcHelp: The application's calls to the kernel, most frequent first ({frames} frames).
